summary: The typed SDD profile-2 transaction separates two checks. Before acceptance, the proposed staged authority runs its declared bounded model checks only; this may refuse an invalid model without replacing accepted bytes, but issues no satisfied production-alignment receipt. After the explicit accepted transaction, sync checks the manifest-bound revision against the actual production reducer, observed action/content replay and correspondence; verify and ship require a fresh satisfied result. The first implementation ran the reducer during proposed preflight, which blocked a valid model whenever code needed repair. The corrected bounded mutant journey accepted revision one while the defective reducer blocked alignment, then a code-only repair passed sync against the same accepted manifest. This is a specific bounded SDD adapter witness, not general implementation equivalence or public-package acceptance. Source integration does not establish publication or fresh/retained installed use.
title: Validate proposed model before acceptance; align production after commit
